digest.component_or_area: git hooks / gerrit integration / build system
propositions: The documented curl command to install the commit-msg hook resolves to the shared hooks directory and silently clobbers the pre-commit wrapper when run from a linked worktree, breaking Change-Id stamping for all worktrees on the host.

The pre-commit hook is configured in MIGRATION mode to chain both the pre-commit wrapper and the Gerrit Change-Id stamper, but the documented curl overwrites the wrapper instead of installing to commit-msg.legacy, breaking the chain and causing silent failures only visible at git push gerrit.

The documented install instructions appear in multiple locations (AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) and must be replaced with a single idempotent path that safely installs or verifies the Gerrit hook without destructive overwrites.

A new scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh script and integration into make hooks ensures the install is worktree-safe, non-destructive, idempotent, payload-validating, and refuses unsafe overwrites with an error message rather than silently corrupting the hook chain.
